identifiers: test_id identifies declared configuration; timestamp identifies this execution; schema_id indexes schemas/library.json

layer_definitions.serialized_payload_bytes: actual serializer output; Struct records per-reading payload while competitor batch tests record the actual serialized envelope
layer_definitions.application_uplink_bytes: actual UDP contents including message security/DTLS; MQTT/HTTP plaintext protocol stream before TLS
layer_definitions.stream_uplink_bytes: actual TCP byte stream including TLS where selected; no TCP/IP headers
layer_definitions.total_uplink_bytes: UDP content plus calculated unfragmented UDP/IP base headers; null for TCP streams
layer_definitions.total_network_bytes: steady exchange under per-field provenance; initialization separately tracked; not cellular/radio bytes
layer_definitions.handshake_bytes: inspect handshake_scope: may include MQTT CONNECT/CONNACK, registration or warmup; not pure TLS/DTLS everywhere
layer_definitions.effective_bytes_per_reading: total_network_bytes divided by logical reading count under the test scope; not always a complete lifecycle
layer_definitions.security_enabled: selected encryption/AEAD mode; legacy HMAC plaintext is false despite integrity/authentication; always inspect security_configuration
layer_definitions.decoding_verified: declared test acceptance/decoding assertion; management and opaque-transfer tests have distinct scopes

provenance: primary record measurement_type plus field-level measurement_provenance; calculated IP headers do not become captured traffic
precision: numeric value semantics under chosen type/conventions, not arbitrary bit-pattern, NaN-payload or signed-zero qualification
comparison: match precision, identity/security properties, response guarantee, lifecycle and measured layer before ranking
raw_references: raw_artifact/raw_line locate original observations with full schema, values, decoded values, errors, hex and timings
retention: large raw files are local/gitignored; archive raw gzip files and artifact hashes for full dataset releases
